name: upwork
description: Connect Upwork to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Upwork MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Upwork to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with freelance jobs and talent using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Upwork workspace.
Find anything in Upwork that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review freelance jobs and talent in Upwork.
